---
title: "About"
description: "What Intelligence Engineering is for."
---

**Intelligence Engineering** is a home for technical notes, experiments and practical explanations concerning contemporary machine intelligence.

The emphasis is not on chasing every new model release. It is on understanding the engineering choices that make models useful: adaptation, retrieval, evaluation, deployment, provenance and decision-making.

Topics will include:

- small and sovereign models;
- fine-tuning and model adaptation;
- summarisation and structured generation;
- retrieval-augmented generation;
- knowledge graphs and GraphRAG;
- evaluation, observability and provenance; and
- emerging decision models and agentic systems.

## A note on the articles

Articles may range from concise field notes to substantial, reproducible investigations. Dates show first publication; material changes should be recorded in an update note.
